name: Azuel
source:
An archangel and Ixseal’s superior.

She supports the valkyrie’s fight remotely from the faraway heavens. While she treats Ixseal and Kyriel with much affection, she is the total opposite when it comes to Tsuguhiko, as the two are constantly at each other’s throats.

[From [url=https://www.mangagamer.com/r18/detail.php?product_code=1471&af=3a123f6214695bfacaa881bd3117c693]MangaGamer[/url]]
